ensv2.note: ENS Labs' dedicated ETHOnline 2026 deployment. Lifetime not announced by ENS Labs -- treat as temporary. Fall back to 'beta' (deploymentId ensv2-sepolia-2026-07-30, g1, addresses below) only if the hackathon deployment goes away before submission. g1 and g2 are different contract generations and are NOT cross-compatible (different resolver initializers/setters, different IUniversalResolverV2 interface ids) -- never mix addresses across the two tables.
ensv2.verification: 3 of the addresses below (universalResolver, rootRegistry, identityRegistry) independently confirmed live via Blockscout on 2026-09-08: all verified contracts, hackathon-generation ones created 2026-09-03, matching the deployment id's timestamp. Remaining addresses (registrar, oracle, paymentToken, resolverFactory, resolverImplementation, resolverProxyLogic, subregistryImplementation, reverseRegistrar) sourced from https://mm-ensv2.estmcmxci.co/reference/deployment but not yet individually re-verified on chain -- do that before relying on them for a real write (resolver deploy / register).

beta.note: fallback only -- g1 generation, not independently re-verified on chain by us

erc8004.note: IdentityRegistry independently verified live on Blockscout 2026-09-08: ERC1967Proxy -> IdentityRegistryUpgradeable, ERC-721 'AgentIdentity' (AGENT), 1462 holders, first tx 2026-01-06 (matches the Jan 2026 mainnet launch). ReputationRegistry not yet independently re-verified. ValidationRegistry has no published address -- per erc-8004/erc-8004-contracts README, that registry is still under active revision with the TEE community. Subgraph should treat it as optional/absent until an address surfaces. Source: https://github.com/erc-8004/erc-8004-contracts (raw README, fetched 2026-09-08).

legacyPermissionGate.note: The one shared demo gate, deployed before PermissionGateFactory existed -- 4-arg constructor (no agentId param), protects agent1/agent2/agent3.mandate.eth. Left untouched; the subgraph keeps a small hardcoded fallback for exactly this one address.

permissionGateFactoryBroken_doNotUse.note: Superseded same day -- createGate's ownership check (IdentityRegistry.isAuthorizedOrOwner) resolves to the adapter contract itself for any ENS-bound identity, never the real owner. Confirmed false even for the legacy gate, a definitely-correct owner. Every self-serve agent is adapter-bound, so this contract rejects every real registration. See docs/self-serve-registration.md. Left deployed (immutable) but unused.

permissionGateFactory.note: Deploys one PermissionGate per agent (5-arg constructor, includes agentId). createGate(agentId, approver, domainName) reverts unless msg.sender genuinely controls agentId per Adapter8004.isController -- the corrected check. Confirmed live end to end: agent 10242's real owner (not the operator) called createGate directly and deployed gate 0x03b5e79A6367f69b2EbD720439b20b240a8fDdFa.
